fact: The baseline report states that 70 per cent of Burundi's hospitals are computerised with an OpenClinic GA record, and that over 85 per cent of sampled hospitals report major problems with unique patient identification and retrieving a patient's earlier record.
title: Étude prospective pour documenter l'apport de l'informatisation dans les hôpitaux du Burundi (Décembre 2022 - janvier 2023)
